question: 9 is related to 80 following a certain logic. Following the same logic. 17 is related to 288. To which of the following is 23 related to, following the same logic?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First Number)² - 1 = Second number

 
• 9 : 80 → 9² - 1 = 81 - 1 = 80
